d: Ghost Adventures brings together some of the most chilling investigations from Season 11. Zak Bagans and the crew enter haunted hotels, abandoned hospitals, historic caverns and other locations with disturbing paranormal claims. From unexplained activity at the Haunted Harvey House and Los Coches Adobe to eerie encounters at Grand Canyon Caverns and Haunted Hollywood, each investigation brings new questions and unexpected discoveries. What will the crew uncover when they step into these haunted locations?
